summary: The People's Movement for Progress (MPP) is a political party in Burkina Faso founded on 25 January 2014 by former Congress for Democracy and Progress member Roch Marc Christian Kaboré. Kaboré was the party's presidential candidate in the November 2015 general election, winning in the first round. The MPP also won a plurality of National Assembly seats and was admitted to Socialist International as a full member in 2016.
one_line: The People's Movement for Progress is a Burkinabè political party founded in 2014 by Roch Marc Christian Kaboré, a Socialist International member since 2016.
key_facts: The People's Movement for Progress (MPP) is a political party in Burkina Faso.
The MPP was founded on 25 January 2014.
The MPP was founded by former Congress for Democracy and Progress member Roch Marc Christian Kaboré.
Roch Marc Christian Kaboré ran as the MPP's presidential candidate in the November 2015 general election.
Roch Marc Christian Kaboré was elected in the first round of the November 2015 presidential voting.
The MPP won a plurality of seats in the National Assembly of Burkina Faso.
The MPP is a full member of Socialist International.
The MPP was admitted to Socialist International in 2016.
